fish.reuse: tileset fish_shadow (1165, 4 fr x 200 ms, alpha-96 shadow) + fish_ripple (1166) at map.ambient.fish_spots - unchanged

jump.frame: 64x96, draw at (spot_x*64, spot_y*64-32); bottom 64 px = the spot cell; waterline y=74
jump.chance: each visible shadow: one jump every 12-30 s (random), never two at once per map; not while raining; not at Night (shadows hide at Night? keep: Night allowed in brookhollow only if fish_spots visible)
jump.sequence: hide the shadow on frame 0, play 13 frames once (total 1.07 s), show the shadow again 1 tile right/left (where the fish landed: +34 px) and resume drifting
jump.direction: right or left at random; use the mirrored strip for left
jump.layer: over water, under characters (frames 2-6 above everything on the water row is fine: the fish stays inside the cell above)
jump.sound: small plip on frame 0, splash on frame 8

birds.asset: flock_bird_* (24x24, foot anchor (12,21), facing right; mirror for left) + flock_bird_shadow (8x3, centre (4,1))
birds.where: route1 dirt paths (playbook 2.5): spawn groups of 3-5 on path cells off-screen-ish, 6-14 px random offsets inside the cell; day/dusk only; none in rain
birds.idle: per bird random loop: peck (4 fr x 120 ms), look (hold 400-900 ms), hop (3 fr x 80 ms, moves 4-8 px), stand; desynchronise with random start

trigger.run_or_bike: player RUNNING or BIKING within 3 tiles (Chebyshev) of a bird -> whole group scatters, staggered 0-120 ms per bird
trigger.walk: WALKING never scatters them (playbook: "scatter when you run, not when you walk"); a bird whose cell the player walks into hops 1 cell aside (hop x2) and keeps pecking
trigger.buddy: the Trail Buddy never scatters them (Sailquill buddy: birds look up = look pose)

scatter.frames: flock_bird_takeoff (2 fr x 50 ms) then flock_bird_fly loop (4 fr x 50 ms)
scatter.path: away from the player: dx = +-5 px/frame (40 ms tick), dy = -3 px/frame, plus random +-1 jitter; shadow stays on the ground and slides with dx, dissolves after 6 ticks
scatter.despawn: when off-screen; respawn the group on another path cell 20-40 s later while it is off-camera

birds.sound: flutter burst on scatter (one per group)

fireflies.asset: firefly_bright (6 fr x 110 ms loop), firefly_dim (6 fr x 160 ms loop), firefly_dim_in (5 fr once; reverse = brighten). 9x9, centre (4,4). EMISSIVE: draw after the night grade, unaffected by it
fireflies.where_when: Night in fernwick (pond x15-18, y20-21) and thornwood (glades); Dusk: half count. Count in fernwick follows sq_fireflies: 3 at sq_fireflies_start, 12 at sq_fireflies_done (8.5-D)
fireflies.motion: code-driven drift per firefly: x = cx + 22*sin(t/1700 + p1) + 6*sin(t/530 + p2), y = cy + 10*sin(t/1100 + p3) - 4; cx,cy = home cell centre; random p1..p3
fireflies.crystal_dim: distance to the nearest crystal ore / dig-scar tile (thornwood (27,11), greystone_entrance (16,12), route1 crystal cluster): <= 2 tiles -> play firefly_dim_in once then firefly_dim; also push the home point 0.5 px/tick away; back outside 2.5 tiles -> reverse dim_in then bright. After the scar is planted with lumen moss (sq_fireflies_scar_N) the radius for that scar is 0

prints.reuse: tileset footprint_{snow,sand,mud}_{dir} for the player (unchanged rule: spawn on the cell left, 3 frames x 1333 ms, max 24)
prints.pawprint: pawprint_{sand,snow,mud}_{dir}: same rule for the Trail Buddy (replaces the human prints the tileset rule currently spawns for the follower). 3 frames x 1333 ms, 64x64 decal, cell top-left, under characters. Flying buddies (Sailquill) leave none
prints.wet: wetprint_{sand,ground}_{dir} (player) and wetpaw_{sand,ground}_{dir} (buddy): after leaving water/shallow (Tideglide dismount, wading Rillop, shallow cells) spawn on the next 6 cells left; frames full/60%/30% x 1000 ms; "sand" on sand ground, "ground" everywhere else except water; none on snow (snow prints win)

splash.splash_ring: 6 fr (460 ms) once per step that ENDS on a shallow-water cell (and every buddy step while Rillop wades); 64x64 decal on that cell, under characters except the drops (fine to draw all of it under the feet)
splash.wade_ring: 4 fr loop while standing in shallow water
splash.shallow_cells: there is no shallow-water tile yet: trigger on cells tagged shallow (World Design to add), and on Rillop wade cells; until then preview uses the route1 sand pond edge

reduced_motion: birds still scatter but fly straight up-out in 6 ticks; fish jumps off (ripples stay); fireflies keep the pulse but drift amplitude halved
